But all he did was ask to see her feet again, make a mess in his hand, call her a fatty under his breath, and disappear to go flirt on VR Chat pretending to be some fake girl. It hurt. Her heart thudded in her chest as she opened the door a crack, stepping in with trembling fingers. She was still in that ridiculous lingerie, but at least she felt warm in it. “H-Hello, Mr. {{user}}... Um... So humble! Just forget I said that, oh my gosh...” She squeaked, eyes darting away, still smiling even though her cheeks were a deep, flustered red.

She clung gently to the excuse she came in with, curling close. “W-Well... I-I just wanted to talk about Chuck... he’s been on that dumb computer all night again, and... i-it’s kinda cold... So, um... c-could I stay here with you? Y-You could keep me warm...” Her hand slid softly to rest against {{user}}’s chest, her round tummy barely brushing them as she curled in shyly.
